stories.title: BEV HV System Component Cross-Reference Indexer
stories.description: Create an index of all High Voltage system components mentioned across BEV KPs (batteries, BMS, OBC, converters, etc). Capture component properties, safety ratings, and which CUs reference them. Enables traceability and consistency checking.
acceptanceCriteria: Create bev-diagnostic-rectification/_reference/hv-component-index.json containing at least 15 HV components with properties (name EN/BM, function, voltage range, safety standard, CUs that mention it)
CLI command 'uv run python scripts/index_hv_components.py' scans all bev-diagnostic-rectification/C**/KP*.md files and auto-builds index
Validation report flags any component mentioned in KP without corresponding safety rating or voltage specification
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/index_hv_components.py (extract_components, validate_safety_fields functions)
File to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/_reference/hv-component-index.json
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_hv_component_index.py -v

stories.title: Aesthetic Client Consultation Script Generator
stories.description: Generate client consultation scripts from Aesthetic C01 (body consultation) KP content. Auto-create bilingual EN/BM dialogue templates for greeting, assessment questions, recommendations, and closing. Used for trainer reference and trainee practice.
acceptanceCriteria: Create aesthetic-services/_tools/consultation-script-generator.py that reads C01/KP*.md and extracts consultation topics
Generate 5+ consultation scripts with EN/BM dialogue structure (greeting→client questions→assessment→recommendations→closing)
Each script includes suggested duration, key assessment points, and product/service recommendation categories
technicalNotes: File to create: aesthetic-services/_tools/consultation-script-generator.py (extract_consultation_topics, generate_script_dialogue functions)
File to modify: aesthetic-services/C01/KP(1/3).md (extract consultation framework)
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_consultation_scripts.py::test_script_dialogue_completeness -v

stories.title: IT-020 Hands-On Lab Activity Mapper
stories.description: Map each IT KP to required hands-on lab exercises. Identify KPs without mapped labs. Supports training delivery planning and ensures practical coverage matches theoretical knowledge.
acceptanceCriteria: Create it-computer-system/lab-activity-mapping.json linking each KP to required lab activities (Level 3, 4, 5 separately)
CLI command 'uv run python scripts/validate_it_lab_coverage.py' reports lab coverage % by level and total unmapped KPs
Identify minimum 8 KPs without mapped lab exercises and suggest lab activity creation titles
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/validate_it_lab_coverage.py (analyze_kp_lab_map, report_coverage_gaps functions)
File to create: it-computer-system/lab-activity-mapping.json with structure {kp_id: [lab_activities]}
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_it_lab_coverage.py -v

stories.title: Assessment Question Time-Box Validator
stories.description: Estimate time required for each KA/PA question based on question type, length, and complexity. Flag assessments exceeding recommended durations. Supports trainer pacing and student time management.
acceptanceCriteria: Create _tools/assessment-time-validator.py that parses all KA/PA files and estimates question time (multiple choice=2min, essay=5-8min, scenario=8-10min, practical=15min)
Generate time allocation CSV report by CU showing question count, total estimated time, and % of recommended limit (KA=60min, PA=90min)
Flag any assessment exceeding 110% of recommended duration and suggest question removal or splitting
technicalNotes: File to create: _tools/assessment-time-validator.py (estimate_question_time, calculate_assessment_duration functions)
File to create: _tools/assessment-time-reports/ folder for CSV outputs
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_assessment_timing.py -v

stories.title: WIM Document Readability Analyzer
stories.description: Analyze FLESCH reading ease and GUNNING FOG readability metrics for all KP/KT/KK documents. Flag content below target readability for student level (Level 3, 4, 5). Supports content clarity improvement.
acceptanceCriteria: Create _tools/readability-analyzer.py using textstat library, scoring FLESCH (target >60 for L3, >65 for L4, >70 for L5)
Generate HTML report showing readability scores, grade level, and problematic paragraphs for each file
CLI command 'uv run python _tools/readability-analyzer.py' scans all **/KP*.md, **/KT*.md, **/KK*.md files
technicalNotes: File to create: _tools/readability-analyzer.py (analyze_file_readability, generate_html_report functions)
Dependency: uv add textstat
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_readability.py -v

stories.title: Cross-Subject Safety Protocol Consolidator
stories.description: Extract all safety procedures mentioned in BEV, Aesthetic, and IT KPs. Consolidate into master safety index with bilingual labels (EN/BM). Identify common safety protocols that could be unified across subjects.
acceptanceCriteria: Create _reference/master-safety-protocols.md listing 30+ safety procedures with bilingual names, CU references, and harmonization notes
Link each safety protocol to source files (file path, CU code, KP section) with cross-reference counts
Identify 10+ safety protocols (PPE, emergency response, hygiene, electrical safety) applicable across multiple subjects
technicalNotes: File to create: _reference/master-safety-protocols.md with markdown table structure [Safety Procedure] | EN | BM | CUs | Unified?
File to create: _tools/safety-protocol-consolidator.py (extract_safety_procedures, cross_reference_protocols functions)
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_safety_consolidation.py -v

stories.title: BEV Diagnostic Fault Code Scenario Generator
stories.description: Generate diagnostic troubleshooting scenarios from actual BEV fault codes (battery, BMS, drivetrain, thermal). Each scenario links to relevant KPs. Creates realistic diagnostic practice cases for KT/KA.
acceptanceCriteria: Create bev-diagnostic-rectification/_tools/fault-code-scenarios.json containing 20+ fault codes with symptoms, diagnostic steps, and solution KP links
CLI command 'uv run python bev-diagnostic-rectification/_tools/generate-scenarios.py' creates diagnostic scenario questions in KT markdown format
Each scenario includes fault code (e.g., P0A80), component, symptoms, diagnosis procedure, and links to relevant C01-C03 KPs
technicalNotes: File to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/_tools/fault-code-scenarios.json with structure {fault_code, component, symptoms[], diagnosis_steps[], relevant_kps[]}
File to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/_tools/generate-scenarios.py (load_fault_codes, create_scenario_question functions)
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_fault_scenarios.py::test_scenario_kp_links -v

stories.title: Aesthetic Electrotherapy Modality Parameter Specification Extractor
stories.description: Extract all electrotherapy modality parameters (frequency, intensity, duration, electrode placement) from Aesthetic C04 KP/KK content. Create master specification sheet. Ensures parameter consistency across all training materials.
acceptanceCriteria: Create aesthetic-services/electrotherapy-parameter-specs.json with 6+ modalities (microcurrent, EMS, RF, ultrasound, LED, laser) and their parameters (frequency Hz, intensity mA, duration min, safety limits)
Validate parameters are consistent across all C04 KP, KK, and KA references using validator script (flag discrepancies)
Include contraindication warnings and safety limits for each modality extracted from KP content
technicalNotes: File to create: aesthetic-services/electrotherapy-parameter-specs.json with structure {modality, frequency_hz, intensity_range, duration_limits, contraindications, safety_standard}
File to create: _tools/extract-modality-parameters.py (parse_kp_parameters, validate_consistency functions)
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_modality_parameters.py -v

stories.title: Assessment Rubric Standardization and Validator
stories.description: Ensure all PA (Performance Assessment) rubrics follow consistent format, scoring scale (1-5, % grades, or descriptive), and language. Standardize rubric structure across all subjects and CUs.
acceptanceCriteria: Create _tools/rubric-standardizer.py that validates all PA files use standard rubric format (competency dimension | level descriptor | score | evidence)
CLI command 'uv run pytest tests/test_rubric_standards.py -v' audits all PA*.md files against standard format and reports compliance %
Generate report showing % compliance and list any rubrics needing reformatting
technicalNotes: File to create: _tools/rubric-standardizer.py (validate_rubric_format, reformat_rubric functions)
File to create: _reference/standard-rubric-template.md defining format and structure
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_rubric_standards.py::test_pa_rubric_format -v

stories.title: Assessment Evidence Traceability Matrix Generator
stories.description: Link each KA/PA question to specific NOSS CoCU Assessment Criteria and learning outcomes. Create audit trail showing which questions assess which competencies. Validates assessment completeness against CoCU.
acceptanceCriteria: Create _tools/evidence-traceability-generator.py that parses KA/PA files and extracts question metadata (question text, type, CoCU criterion link, bloom's level)
Generate JSON matrix showing question ID → CoCU assessment criterion → expected learning outcome mapping
Identify any CoCU assessment criteria not covered by any question for each subject
technicalNotes: File to create: _tools/evidence-traceability-generator.py (extract_question_metadata, build_traceability_matrix functions)
File to create: _tools/traceability-reports/evidence-matrix.json with structure {question_id, kp_link, cocu_criterion, learning_outcome, question_type}
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_traceability.py::test_criterion_coverage -v

stories.title: Equipment and Tools Inventory with Safety Ratings
stories.description: Extract all equipment and tools mentioned in KK (practical worksheets) across all subjects. Create master inventory with safety certifications, supplier info, and PPE requirements. Supports procurement and safety planning.
acceptanceCriteria: Create _reference/tools-equipment-inventory.json containing 50+ tools/equipment with EN/BM names, safety standards (ISO/CE), usage frequency (high/medium/low), and PPE requirements
CLI command 'uv run python _tools/extract-tools-inventory.py' parses all **/KK*.md files and auto-populates inventory

technicalNotes: File to create: _reference/tools-equipment-inventory.json with structure {tool_name_en, tool_name_bm, category, safety_standard, ppe_required, frequency}
File to create: _tools/extract-tools-inventory.py (scan_kk_files, extract_tools, classify_safety_level functions)
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_tools_inventory.py -v

stories.title: WIM Document Maturity Scorecard Generator
stories.description: Rate each WIM document (KP/KT/KK/KA/PA) on multiple maturity dimensions: content completeness, format compliance, technical accuracy, bilingual coverage, and assessment quality. Generate scorecards per CU and project-wide summary.
acceptanceCriteria: Create _tools/maturity-scorecard.py that scores each document on 10+ criteria (header box present, bilingual coverage >80%, internal consistency, no dead links, assessment questions mapped to CoCU, safety procedures documented, etc)
Generate HTML scorecards for each CU folder showing maturity scores and recommendations
Show overall project maturity % broken down by subject (BEV, Aesthetic, IT) and document type (KP, KT, KK, KA, PA)
technicalNotes: File to create: _tools/maturity-scorecard.py (score_document_maturity, generate_scorecard_html functions)
File to create: _tools/maturity-reports/ folder for HTML scorecards
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_maturity_scoring.py -v

stories.title: IT Network Scenario Contemporary Standards Validator
stories.description: Scan IT KP/KT/KA files for outdated technology references (pre-2020 networking standards, deprecated protocols, legacy systems). Flag for modernization. Ensures IT scenarios reflect current industry practices.
acceptanceCriteria: Create _tools/it-scenario-validator.py that flags references to deprecated technologies (IPv4-only, Windows Server 2012, SSL 3.0, unsegmented networks, MPLS-only, physical servers only)
CLI command reports all deprecated references by file with modernization suggestions (IPv6, containers, zero-trust security, cloud integration, microservices)
Flag 10+ outdated references and suggest contemporary equivalents with rationale
technicalNotes: File to create: _tools/it-scenario-validator.py (identify_deprecated_tech, suggest_modernization functions)
File to create: _reference/it-deprecated-tech-map.json mapping old→new tech equivalents with rationale
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_it_standards.py -v

stories.title: Practical Assessment Safety Checklist Auto-Generator
stories.description: Extract all safety considerations from KK (practical worksheets) procedures. Auto-generate comprehensive bilingual safety checklists for each PA (Performance Assessment). Each checkpoint includes procedure step, hazard, control measure, and evidence criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: Create _tools/pa-safety-checklist-generator.py that parses all KK*.md files and extracts safety keywords (hazard, warning, precaution, PPE, procedure step, danger)
Generate bilingual safety checklists (EN/BM) for each CU PA with minimum 15 checkpoints covering procedure safety, hazard identification, and control measures
Each checkpoint includes: procedure step | hazard description | control measure | evidence criteria (verbal/observation/signature)
technicalNotes: File to create: _tools/pa-safety-checklist-generator.py (extract_safety_points, generate_checklist_markdown functions)
File to create: _tools/safety-checklist-templates/pa-checklist-template.md
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_safety_checklists.py::test_checklist_coverage -v

stories.title: Assessment Question Bloom's Cognitive Level Auditor
stories.description: Classify all KA/PA questions by Bloom's Taxonomy cognitive level (Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate, Create). Analyze distribution across all subjects. Identify imbalances and suggest rewriting suggestions.
acceptanceCriteria: Create _tools/blooms-auditor.py that parses KA/PA question text and classifies each by cognitive level using keyword matching (define=Remember, explain=Understand, solve=Apply, compare=Analyze, critique=Evaluate, design=Create)
Generate report showing % of questions at each Bloom's level per CU and overall distribution across all subjects
Flag CUs with imbalanced cognitive distribution (e.g., >50% Remember questions) and suggest specific questions to upgrade to higher levels
technicalNotes: File to create: _tools/blooms-auditor.py (classify_question_level, analyze_level_distribution, suggest_upgrades functions)
File to create: _reference/blooms-keyword-map.json mapping keywords/question structures to cognitive levels
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_blooms_classification.py -v
